## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file.
### Skill roots
- `r0` = `/Users/x/.agents/skills`
- `r1` = `/Users/x/.codex/skills/.system`
- `r6` = `/Users/x/.codex/plugins/cache/ma-probe`
- `r7` = `/Users/x/.codex/plugins/cache/my-plugins`
### Available skills
- ma-probe:ma-probe-dir: Probe skill in a skills folder. Use when asked to use ma-probe-dir. (file: r6/ma-probe/0.0.1/skills/ma-probe-dir/SKILL.md)
- my-agent:monitor: Start, check, or stop the made-up monitor page. Run only when called as /my-agent:monitor. (file: r7/my-agent/0.7.0/skills/monitor/SKILL.md)
- skill-creator: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources. (file: r1/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- find-skills: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X". (file: r0/find-skills/SKILL.md)
- pdf: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files, made-up text for the fixture. (file: r0/pdf/SKILL.md)
</skills_instructions>
Reply with exactly: ok. Do not run any command.
